assessment: In this manuscript, the authors proposed a novel and attractive model to address a fundamental question of how the locational and function of axon guidance molecules are regulated. They presented convincing data to support their working model. They showed important findings that Sema3E-Plexin-D1 signaling regulates the expression of Mtss1, which regulates the localization of Plexin-D1 and contributes to striatonigral axonal growth and turning.
